items.title: The Tangled Web
items.author: Michał Zalewski
items.description: Deep technical guide to securing modern web applications. Covers browser security models, same-origin policy, content security, and the underlying mechanics that make web vulnerabilities possible. Essential reading for serious web security work.

items.title: Practical Ethical Hacking
items.author: TCM Security
items.description: Hands-on entry into offensive security with a strong network-pentest focus. Good first step before OSCP-style training.

items.title: TCM Security Academy
items.author: TCM Security
items.description: Affordable, hands-on training platform covering offensive security from foundations through advanced topics — Practical Ethical Hacking, Practical Network Penetration Tester (PNPT) certification path, Linux/Windows privilege escalation, OSINT, malware development, and more. Strong production quality and active community.

items.title: TryHackMe
items.description: Guided learning paths and approachable, beginner-friendly content across blue-team and offensive foundations.

items.title: Hack The Box
items.description: Broader hands-on ecosystem with structured Academy modules covering offensive and defensive topics, plus deeper independent challenge content for more advanced practice.

items.title: PortSwigger Web Security Academy
items.author: PortSwigger
items.description: Free, comprehensive online training with hands-on labs covering web application security. Built by the team behind Burp Suite. Excellent for learning real-world web vulnerabilities including SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, SSRF, authentication flaws, and more.

items.title: Antisyphon Pay-What-You-Can Training
items.author: Black Hills Information Security
items.description: Live and on-demand security training from the Black Hills team on a pay-what-you-can model, including free seats. Strong coverage across SOC operations, incident response, threat hunting, active defense, and offensive tradecraft, taught by working practitioners.

items.title: Sektor7 Institute
items.author: Reenz0h
items.description: Deep technical offensive security training focused on Windows internals, malware development, and red team tradecraft. Courses cover initial access, persistence, privilege escalation, EDR evasion, and custom tooling for serious offensive practitioners.

items.title: Kibana
items.author: Elastic
items.description: Useful for searching, visualizing, and investigating log data in Elastic-based environments.

items.title: Wireshark
items.description: Packet analysis staple for digging deeper into network behavior and validating suspicious activity.

items.title: Sysmon
items.author: Microsoft Sysinternals
items.description: High-value Windows telemetry source for process creation, network connections, and host-based investigations.

items.title: PowerShell Logging
items.description: Important log source for script execution visibility, attacker behavior tracing, and post-incident review.

items.title: VMware Workstation Pro
items.author: Broadcom
items.description: Free-for-personal-use type-2 hypervisor for running virtual machines on Windows and Linux. Essential for building a home lab, isolating malware analysis environments, and standing up the attacker and defender systems you need for any practical security learning.

items.title: OSBoxes
items.author: OSBoxes
items.description: Pre-built VirtualBox and VMware images for dozens of Linux distributions. Skip installation friction when you need a clean lab VM fast — useful for analysis sandboxes, attack platforms, and quickly testing new tools without rebuilding from scratch.

items.title: Darknet Diaries
items.author: Jack Rhysider
items.description: True stories from the dark side of the internet — hackers, breaches, and the people behind them. Approachable for newcomers, fun for veterans.

items.title: IppSec
items.description: Walkthroughs of retired Hack The Box machines that build real offensive technique pattern recognition.

items.title: STÖK
items.author: Fredrik Alexandersson
items.description: Bug bounty hunter and creator making web hacking approachable and fun. Strong content on bug bounty methodology, recon, collaboration, and the mindset side of offensive security.

items.title: Jason Haddix (jhaddix)
items.description: Veteran bug bounty hunter and creator of The Bug Hunter's Methodology. Shares recon techniques, web hacking methodology, and AI-assisted security workflows. Most active on X, where he posts tradecraft and methodology threads.

items.title: NahamSec
items.author: Ben Sadeghipour
items.description: Bug bounty hunter and educator behind NahamCon. Live recon sessions, hunter interviews, and practical guidance for getting started in bug bounty and web application hacking.

items.title: 13Cubed
items.author: Richard Davis
items.description: Deep, methodical walkthroughs of Windows forensics, memory analysis, and DFIR tooling that build real investigative skill.

items.title: John Hammond
items.description: Accessible technical walkthroughs across malware analysis, CTFs, real-world incidents, and security tooling. One of the best channels for seeing hands-on analysis explained clearly.

items.title: MITRE ATT&CK
items.author: MITRE
items.description: The shared language for adversary behavior. Useful for detection engineering, threat hunting, purple teaming, and report writing.

items.title: GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA)
items.author: GIAC
items.description: Strong analyst-focused credential around intrusion analysis, traffic inspection, and network-centered investigation.

items.title: Certified Digital Forensics Professional (eCDFP)
items.author: INE / eLearnSecurity
items.description: Useful path for developing forensic investigation skills that support host analysis and incident response depth.

items.title: CompTIA Security+
items.author: CompTIA
items.description: Industry-standard foundational security certification covering threats, vulnerabilities, architecture, identity, operations, and incident response. Common HR filter for entry-level security roles and a solid baseline for anyone breaking into the field.

items.title: SOC Level 1 Analyst (SAL1)
items.author: TryHackMe
items.description: Practical SOC analyst certification covering alert triage, threat intelligence, network and endpoint analysis, and digital forensics through hands-on labs and a 24-hour practical exam. Strong validation for entry-level defensive roles.

items.title: Certified Defensive Security Analyst (CDSA)
items.author: Hack The Box
items.description: Hands-on defensive security certification covering SOC operations, incident handling, threat hunting, and digital forensics. The 7-day practical exam requires you to investigate and write a professional report on a realistic intrusion.

items.title: OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional)
items.author: OffSec
items.description: The flagship hands-on offensive security certification. A 24-hour practical exam where you compromise multiple machines and write a professional penetration test report. Widely recognized as strong proof of real offensive skill and a common requirement for pen testing roles.

items.title: Blue Team Level 1 (BTL1)
items.author: Security Blue Team
items.description: Practical entry-level defensive certification covering phishing analysis, threat intelligence, digital forensics, SIEM and log analysis, and incident response. Hands-on exam where you investigate a realistic incident end-to-end. Strong validation for entry-level SOC roles.

items.title: CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)
items.author: (ISC)²
items.description: Management-level security certification covering security architecture, asset security, communications and network security, identity and access management, security operations, software security, and risk management. Common requirement for senior and leadership security roles.

items.title: Certified Red Team Operator (CRTO)
items.author: Zero-Point Security
items.description: Hands-on red team certification covering Cobalt Strike tradecraft, command-and-control, Active Directory attacks, lateral movement, evasion, and persistence. Practical 48-hour exam in a realistic enterprise environment. Strong proof of real red team capability.

items.title: OSEP (Offensive Security Experienced Penetration Tester)
items.author: OffSec
items.description: Advanced offensive certification focused on evasion: AV/EDR bypass, custom payload development, Active Directory attacks, lateral movement, code-signing attacks, and application allowlisting bypass. Practical 48-hour exam against a hardened enterprise environment.

items.title: Security B-Sides
items.author: Community-run
items.description: Community-run security conferences held in cities worldwide as affordable, accessible alternatives to large industry events. Find the closest one to you on the Security B-Sides site. Great way to meet local practitioners and present early work.

items.title: SimplyCyber Con
items.author: Simply Cyber
items.description: Free virtual conference from Gerald Auger's Simply Cyber community, built for people breaking into and growing in cybersecurity. Accessible talks from practitioners across defensive and offensive disciplines. I presented on purple teaming here in 2025.

items.title: DEF CON
items.author: Las Vegas, NV
items.description: The world's largest and most well-known hacker conference, held annually in Las Vegas. Talks across every security domain, dozens of villages (red team, blue team, hardware, ICS, AI/ML, social engineering, lockpicking, and more), and large-scale CTFs.

items.title: Wild West Hackin' Fest
items.author: Black Hills Information Security
items.description: Multi-day security conference put on by Black Hills, with a strong focus on practical offensive and defensive tradecraft. Held in Deadwood, South Dakota and online. Excellent community vibe and practitioner-led talks.
